actor-start.eventDescription: apify-actor-start: charged automatically by the Apify platform when the run starts, one event per GB of memory (default 1 GB = 1 event).

listing.eventDescription: Charged per product extracted in listing-only mode (includeDetails: false). Never charged for failed rows or shop summary rows.

product-detail.eventDescription: Charged per product extracted with full details, SKUs, attributes, and images (includeDetails: true). Never charged for failed rows or shop summary rows.

final-price.eventDescription: Add-on charged only when a coupon, shop discount, or threshold deal (满X减Y) is applied and priceType is 'exact_final'. Never charged for plain listed promo prices or partial deals.
